artifact.status: analytic derivation plus exploratory numerical evidence; no interval theorem claimed

method: Numerically isolate global and right-half characteristic roots with SciPy bracketing, refine roots to 60 decimal digits with mpmath, evaluate exact residues from the normalized full/right characteristic functions and their derivatives, then inspect psi_X' and mode-truncation stability.

results.low_mode_short_time_failure: At t=0.0015, 10/15/20-mode truncations give the wrong sign; 30 modes turn negative and 40-60 modes stabilize.

limitations: Root seeds are found by floating-point scans before high-precision refinement; this is not a rigorous interval root-isolation certificate.
The infinite residue tail is not enclosed by this exploratory script.
The apparent unique zero of psi_X' is not yet proved.
next_certification: Build interval root and residue enclosures from the characteristic-function formula.
Certify N_X<0 up to 0.0144, N_X>0 from 0.0145 to 0.020, and N_X'>0 on the bracket.
Use B2/B3 dominance plus an analytic high-mode tail bound to prove f_X'<0 and f_X''>0 for t>=0.020.
Connect the t downarrow 0 region with a differentiable short-time reflection-path estimate.
